title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 43 (Road 248)
heading: Road 248

Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Road 248
43 That portion of the Province of British Columbia, in the vicinity of Beatton Provincial Park, that is within 50 metres of either side of the midline of Number 248 Road. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 2.]
